# Curtner Pet Clinic & Hospital

> > Full-service veterinary clinic serving San Jose and the South Bay area with two convenient locations led by Dr. Rami Dadwal, DVM.

Curtner Pet Clinic & Hospital operates two locations in San Jose, California: the main Curtner Pet Clinic on Curtner Ave and Curtner Pet Hospital inside PetSmart. The practice provides comprehensive veterinary care and pet healthcare services to the local community.
